style: Bright modern flat vector illustration with soft cel shading and gentle gradients, one consistent dark navy outline (about 3% of the canvas width), rounded friendly shapes, cheerful saturated palette (teal #2ec4b6, coral #ff6b6b, sunflower #ffd23f, sky #4cc9f0, mint #3ddc84, plum #7b2cbf, warm cream #fff4e0), light from the top left, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, crisp edges, readable at 64 px on a phone. Same art direction for every asset of the set, like one mobile game's sticker sheet.

assets.prompt: A whole little harbour town seen from above at a three-quarter angle (about 35 degrees), as one cheerful mobile game board in landscape 3:2: a town square with a clock tower in the middle; curvy, imperfect asphalt streets with white dashes and crossings winding between the buildings, with several bends and a crossroads, no ring road; a bay with a quay, a pier, a wharf with cranes and containers, boats, a canal crossed by a footbridge, and a lighthouse in the bottom right. Fourteen buildings face the streets: a shared house, a letting agency, a glass residential tower, a grocery store, a fintech bank, a modern factory, a job centre, a red-brick college, an electronics store, a clothing boutique, a drive-thru burger joint, a big-box discount store, a second-hand shop and the port with its harbour office. Buildings, streets and water fill the frame edge to edge, only small patches of lawn and trees between them. Opaque, no text, no labels, no signs with letters.
